# Third-party notices

Devbox is licensed under the MIT License (see `LICENSE`). This file lists the third-party software that ships with it, with the license text each package provides. It is generated by `cargo run -p xtask -- notices` from the inputs fingerprinted in its first line (the lock files, the manifests and the license text of each bundled font); do not edit it by hand.

Packages by source:

- Rust crates of the WSL `devbox` command (`Cargo.lock`, every platform): 388
- Rust crates of the Windows app (`app/src-tauri/Cargo.lock`, `x86_64-pc-windows-msvc`): 292
- npm packages of the app UI (`pnpm-lock.yaml`, production): 255
- Fonts bundled with the app UI (`app/src/assets/fonts`, listed in `xtask/src/notices/bundled.rs`): 1

768 distinct packages in total: a package that two sources share counts once. Packages that ship the same license text are listed together under one copy of it, and a package with several license files, for example the license of code it vendors, is listed under each.
